quarterly_data.quarter: SOPHiA GENETICS press release: SOPHiA GENETICS and Myriad Genetics Announce New (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SOPHiA GENETICS and Myriad Genetics announced a collaboration to advance Myriad's prostate cancer-specific genomic instability score (PrGIS) technology, a biomarker signature for homologous recombination deficiency (HRD), to support precision oncology approaches with AstraZeneca; the collaboration aims to advance PrGIS in clinical trials and expand access through potential companion diagnostic solutions. As part of it, SOPHiA is developing its solid tumor application for Extended Homologous Recombination Solution into a decentralized companion diagnostic solution that will incorporate Myriad's PrGIS technology, aiming to expand patient access to PrGIS in global markets. No financial terms were stated.
